show.description: “Saas Bahu aur Drama” is a quirky tale of Savita, a sharp-tongued mother-in-law, and her ambitious daughter-in-law Ritu. When Ritu’s bold choices clash with Savita’s traditional ways, the household turns into a battlefield of witty comebacks, unexpected twists, and shocking family secrets.
